description: This file contains JavaScript functions for rendering and interacting with SQL pages, including dynamic card content, sortable and searchable tables, map integration with Leaflet, form validation, and bootstrap component initialization.

methods.name: sqlpage_card
methods.description: Fetches embedded content and updates card elements with new HTML, removing loading placeholders.

methods.name: setup_table
methods.description: Initializes a table with search and sort functionalities, and applies number formatting.

methods.name: setup_table_search_behavior
methods.description: Sets up search input to filter table rows based on user input.

methods.name: apply_number_formatting
methods.description: Formats number and currency cells in the table according to specified locale and formatting options.

methods.name: table_parse_data
methods.description: Parses table rows to extract data for sorting.

methods.name: setup_sort_behavior
methods.description: Attaches click events to sort buttons to sort table rows based on column data.

methods.name: sqlpage_table
methods.description: Initializes all tables marked for SQL page setup.

methods.name: sqlpage_map
methods.description: Sets up Leaflet maps, including loading Leaflet scripts and creating markers.

methods.name: addMarker
methods.description: Adds a marker to the map, either from coordinates or GeoJSON data.

methods.name: createMarker
methods.description: Creates a Leaflet marker with optional custom icon.

methods.name: createGeoJSONMarker
methods.description: Creates a Leaflet GeoJSON marker with styling.

methods.name: sqlpage_form
methods.description: Sets up file size validation and auto-submit behavior for forms.

methods.name: get_tabler_color
methods.description: Retrieves CSS variable for Tabler color themes.

methods.name: load_scripts
methods.description: Dynamically loads additional scripts specified in data attributes.

methods.name: add_init_fn
methods.description: Registers functions to run on DOMContentLoaded and fragment-loaded events.

methods.name: init_bootstrap_components
methods.description: Initializes Bootstrap components like tooltips, popovers, dropdowns, and carousels.

methods.name: open_modal_for_hash
methods.description: Opens modal dialogs based on URL hash changes.
